query: In which city is the ambassador of the Rabat-Salé-Kénitra administrative region to China based?

pipeline_result.response: The Moroccan Ambassador to Beijing is based in Rabat. The context provided does not specify the exact location within China, only that he serves as the official representative of the Government in Rabat to the Government of the People's Republic of China there.
retrieved_context: Rabat: Rabat (Berber: , Arabic: الرِّبَاط‎ ‎ , Moroccan Arabic: رّباط‎ ‎ ) is the capital city of Morocco and its second largest city with an urban population of approximately 580,000 (2014) and a metropolitan population of over 1.2 million.  It is also the capital city of the Rabat-Salé-Kénitra administrative region.
Moroccan Ambassador to China: The Moroccan ambassador in Beijing is the official representative of the Government in Rabat to the Government of the People's Republic of China.

Macau: Macau ( ), also spelled Macao and officially the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, is an autonomous region on the western side of the Pearl River estuary in East Asia.  Macau is bordered by the city of Zhuhai in Mainland China to the north and the Pearl River Delta to the east and south.  Hong Kong lies about 64 km to its east across the Delta.  With a population of 650,900 living in an area of 30.5 km2 , it is the most densely populated region in the world.  A former Portuguese colony, it was returned to Chinese sovereignty on 20 December 1999.
